answer_inference_leases_identity_check.name: answer_inference_leases_identity_check
answer_inference_leases_identity_check.value: length("answer_inference_leases"."provider") between 1 and 64 and length("answer_inference_leases"."model") between 1 and 256

answer_inference_leases_amount_check.name: answer_inference_leases_amount_check
answer_inference_leases_amount_check.value: "answer_inference_leases"."maximum_output_tokens" between 1 and 8192 and "answer_inference_leases"."reserved_microdollars" between 1 and 2000000000 and ("answer_inference_leases"."charged_microdollars" is null or "answer_inference_leases"."charged_microdollars" between 0 and "answer_inference_leases"."reserved_microdollars")

answer_inference_leases_usage_check.name: answer_inference_leases_usage_check
answer_inference_leases_usage_check.value: ("answer_inference_leases"."input_tokens" is null or "answer_inference_leases"."input_tokens" >= 0) and ("answer_inference_leases"."output_tokens" is null or "answer_inference_leases"."output_tokens" >= 0)

answer_inference_leases_lifecycle_check.name: answer_inference_leases_lifecycle_check
answer_inference_leases_lifecycle_check.value: ("answer_inference_leases"."status" = 'active' and "answer_inference_leases"."charged_microdollars" is null and "answer_inference_leases"."reconciled_at" is null) or ("answer_inference_leases"."status" <> 'active' and "answer_inference_leases"."charged_microdollars" is not null and "answer_inference_leases"."reconciled_at" is not null)

conversation_analytics_identity_check.name: conversation_analytics_identity_check
conversation_analytics_identity_check.value: length("conversation_analytics"."id") = 36 and length("conversation_analytics"."provider") between 1 and 64 and length("conversation_analytics"."model") between 1 and 256

conversation_analytics_measurements_chec.name: conversation_analytics_measurements_check
conversation_analytics_measurements_chec.value: "conversation_analytics"."duration_milliseconds" between 0 and 300000 and ("conversation_analytics"."first_token_milliseconds" is null or "conversation_analytics"."first_token_milliseconds" between 0 and "conversation_analytics"."duration_milliseconds") and ("conversation_analytics"."input_tokens" is null or "conversation_analytics"."input_tokens" between 0 and 1000000) and ("conversation_analytics"."output_tokens" is null or "conversation_analytics"."output_tokens" between 0 and 1000000) and ("conversation_analytics"."cost_microdollars" is null or "conversation_analytics"."cost_microdollars" between 0 and 2000000000)

embedding_jobs_attempts_check.name: embedding_jobs_attempts_check
embedding_jobs_attempts_check.value: "embedding_jobs"."attempts" between 0 and "embedding_jobs"."maximum_attempts" and "embedding_jobs"."maximum_attempts" between 1 and 10 and "embedding_jobs"."checkpoint" >= 0

embedding_jobs_lease_check.name: embedding_jobs_lease_check
embedding_jobs_lease_check.value: "embedding_jobs"."status" <> 'leased' or ("embedding_jobs"."lease_token" is not null and "embedding_jobs"."lease_expires_at" is not null)

support_handoffs_lifecycle_check.name: support_handoffs_lifecycle_check
support_handoffs_lifecycle_check.value: ("support_handoffs"."status" = 'pending' and "support_handoffs"."finished_at" is null) or ("support_handoffs"."status" <> 'pending' and "support_handoffs"."finished_at" is not null)
